description: Display-board tickers (stoerungkurz) of Wiener-Linien incidents WL marked resolved. src/providers/wl_resolved.py drops them while WL still sends them; key = name|start|title. owners: name|start of each ticker -> the incident its start dates, the ticker's title then and, for a ticker rewritten for a newer incident, that incident's begin (rewritten_starts).
